name: Ruix
source:
The high-ranking demon of the Demon World. Although he was given the task to invade the Earth, he repeatedly failed to complete the task. He is a very cruel man, but he was also somewhat naive. His subordinates constantly left him, because of Mikaela thwarting his plans all the time. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=756865]Getchu[/url]
